NGA.note: Committee and forum are set up or have met; neither is said to have given a view on a named digital law.

facts.fact: NAN reports the Nigerian Startup Act was signed into law on 19 October 2022, with NITDA as its implementing secretariat.
NAN reports the Startup Consultative Forum's membership includes labelled startups, and that certified startups get access to incentives under the Act.

NGA.note: Incubators and hubs are named as forum members only; no hub or programme is described.
